svg.title: ARMOR-DEVOPS architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-DEVOPS installs the server, Studio, the network node, the observation and voice services and the broker on the CM5 test bench with a user, a directory and ports of their own, builds and publishes the signed package of each release, keeps two helpers (an administration agent with a closed list and a maintenance agent that updates components from GitHub with a rollback), and holds the Docker Compose topology with its optional TLS profile, the broker rules, the firewall, the backup and restore and the VPN and dynamic-name helpers.
